tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/compression.md <<'EOF'
# Transport compression policy

The project's current recorded decision is to use zstd as the transport compression codec, chosen because it compresses better than the alternatives considered and decompresses much faster on both the sending and receiving ends.
EOF
cat docs/policies/compression.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/compression.md`. It has a title and one paragraph saying the current recorded decision is zstd, chosen because it compresses better and decompresses much faster on both ends. I only wrote the file and didn't commit it.

The project's memory holds two decisions on this. The earlier one (#3) chose gzip. The later one (#5) says "Actually zstd compresses better…", and I treated that as replacing the gzip decision. The record doesn't link the two explicitly. The paragraph doesn't mention gzip.
